body.name: \(F(\rho),\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)\)
body.construction:
For a prefix \(\rho=(\varnothing=A_0\to A_1\to\cdots\to A_k=A)\) in the full removed-set lattice, where \(A_s=A_{s-1}\cup\{r_s\}\), define \(F(\rho)\) by placing \(\beta(A_{s-1},r_s)\) in original row slot \(r_s\) for \(s=1,\ldots,k\) and leaving the other slots unassigned. Define
\[
 \operatorname{Comp}(\rho)=
 \{T_\pi:\pi\in\mathfrak S_V\text{ extends }\rho\}.
\]
Every subset vertex and every prefix is live in this full-lattice construction.
